title: Leveled
summary: LEV'ELED, participle passive 1. Reduced to a plane; made even. 2. Reduced to an equal state, condition or rank. 3. Reduced to an equality with something else. 4. Elevated or depressed to a right line

inlines.v: LEV'ELED, participle passive 1. Reduced to a plane; made even. 2. Reduced to an equal state, condition or rank. 3. Reduced to an equality with something else. 4. Elevated or depressed to a right line towards something; pointed to an object; directed to a mark. 5. Suited; proportioned.
